chunks: And by his chain, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said regarding the words of the Exalted and Mighty God:
(…that should hear the tale and retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance)
He said: I asked God to establish that to be your ears, O Ali.

key_terms.أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ: An attentive/hearing ear (capacity to receive and retain)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet's prayer for Imam Ali's ears in relation to the Quranic verse 'Wa ta'iyaha udhunun waqiyyah'?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* elucidates the Quranic phrase 'udhunun waqiyyah' (ears that heed and retain) by linking it directly to Imam Ali (a.s.), suggesting his ears were divinely selected to preserve the Prophet's teachings. This interpretation underscores the Shia belief in the Ahl al-Bayt's unique role as the living repositories of divine wisdom, where their auditory reception is synonymous with theological accuracy and preservation of the Sunnah.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-256 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), “Regarding the Honorable the Exalted God’s words in the following verse, ‘
…(that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance,’
God’s Prophet said, ‘I asked God to establish that to be your ears.’”
